question.text: Which entities are mandated by PMLA and PML Rules to adhere to client account opening procedures, maintain records, and report transactions?

answer.text: All intermediaries registered under Section 12 of the SEBI Act, 1992 and stock exchanges

explanation.text: The Logic: The PMLA and PML Rules mandate reporting entities, which include all intermediaries registered under Section 12 of the SEBI Act, 1992 and stock exchanges, to follow client account opening procedures, maintain prescribed records, and report transactions as required. The Trap: The obligation is not limited to brokers and DPs alone, nor to mutual fund distributors only. The wording in the SEBI/PMLA framework refers broadly to Section 12 intermediaries plus stock exchanges. Note: AML measures should be calibrated to the intermediary's business, client and transaction profile, so the way these obligations are implemented can vary across entities.
